description_en: Queries all Logstores or Logstores that match specific conditions in a project
description_zh: 查询指定Project下所有或匹配的LogStore列表
name: ListLogStores

parameters.help_en: The line from which the query starts. Default value: 0
parameters.name: offset

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 500. Default value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置的每页行数。最大值为500。默认值为200
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: The name of the Logstore. Fuzzy match is supported. For example, if you enter test, Logstores whose name contains test are returned
parameters.help_zh: Logstore名称。支持模糊匹配，例如输入test，则返回名称包含test的Logstore列表
parameters.name: logstore_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data that you want to query. Valid values:

None: logs

Metrics: metrics
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的日志类型。取值包括：

None：查询所有日志类型。
Metrics：查询Metrics类型
parameters.name: telemetry_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the Logstore. Valid values: standard and query.

standard: Standard Logstore. This type of Logstore supports the log analysis feature and is suitable for scenarios such as real-time monitoring and interactive analysis. You can also use this type of Logstore to build a comprehensive observability system.

query: Query Logstore. This type of Logstore supports high-performance queries. The index traffic fee of a Query Logstore is approximately half that of a Standard Logstore. Query Logstores do not support SQL analysis. Query Logstores are suitable for scenarios in which the volume of data is large, the log retention period is long, or log analysis is not required. Log retention periods of weeks or months are considered long
parameters.help_zh:
日志服务提供标准型（Standard）和查询型（Query）两种类型的Logstore。
standard：支持日志服务一站式数据分析功能，适用于实时监控、交互式分析以及构建完整的可观测性系统等场景。
query：支持高性能查询，索引流量费用约为Standard的一半，但不支持SQL分析，适用于数据量大、存储周期长（周、月级别以上）、无日志分析的场景
parameters.name: mode

schema.title_en: 是否长链接。取值包括：  close：不是长链接，则每个HTTP请求都会重新建立TCP连接。 keep-alive：长链接，TCP连接建立后保持连接状态，节省连接所需时间和带宽。
schema.title_zh: 是否长链接。取值包括：  close：不是长链接，则每个HTTP请求都会重新建立TCP连接。 keep-alive：长链接，TCP连接建立后保持连接状态，节省连接所需时间和带宽。

schema.title_en: 返回的响应体的内容格式。
schema.title_zh: 返回的响应体的内容格式。

schema.title_zh: 服务端产生的标识，该请求的唯一ID。

total.description_en: The number of the Logstores that meet the query conditions
